changes: Studio busy remains true until its owned generation and any background/memory cleanup have both settled.
One identified cleanup task merges repeated events and awaits the captured operation before unloading.
A memory cleanup gains its single background lease if the app backgrounds while cleanup is pending.
Expired and normally completed background assertions use the same idempotent end operation, including synchronous expiration during begin.
Stop-latency publication waits for cleanup; old operation completion is guarded by operation identity.
ModelManager marks loaded=false and unloading busy before suspension; concurrent unload callers join a task that finalizes state before returning.
Existing DEVICE_QA admission guard and mutable busy API are preserved.

productionPathCoverage: Actual StudioModel admission and cleanup while injected model-unload effect is held by a gate.
Real ProjectStore and native export preserve an existing revision, reject retry during cleanup, and allow a new saved revision afterward.
Repeated memory/background events coalesce; background after memory cleanup acquires one assertion.
Expiration ends immediately; later completion and repeated end calls do not end twice.
Synchronous expiration during begin remains balanced.
Actual ModelManager unload coalescing and prepare rejection during unloading; each caller returns only after unload state finalization.

warnings.message: Existing Text concatenation deprecated in iOS 26; file outside this change.

cancellationPropagationReviewed: StudioModel.cancel cancels the captured owned operation.
QwenEngine.generateJSONDirect forwards cancellation to its owned task and producer, and awaits producer settlement.
PrefillParameters.forEachChunk checks cancellation before each chunk.
Geometry/export own detached tasks receive cancellation through scoped handlers; geometry budget is 20000 vertices and 80000 indices.

unboundedNativeWaitBoundaries.operation: Model container/tokenizer loading; checks cancellation after load returns.
Input/tokenizer preparation; checks cancellation after preparation.
Await actual producer settlement before releasing model state.

remainingStopLatencyReview.conclusion: The fixes close the reproduced lifecycle/lease races and the reviewed joiner boundary. They do not establish a maximum cancellation duration for native loading or GPU work, and no additional source-plus-reproduction evidence identifies the reported over-100-second cause. Do not mark work idle while native resources remain in flight.
